title: arc config.yaml
description: Declarative contract for ~/.config/arc/config.yaml. Per CHOICES U-0005: config declares what should exist; ledger tracks liveness via heartbeats. No transport, auth, or endpoint fields — those are the module's internal business. See docs/adr/0002-ux-module-contract.md.

ux_modules.description: Registered UX modules fulfilling the UX Module Contract.

name.description: Unique module id (e.g. arc-webui, arc-tui, arc-discord). Used as module_name in hitl_deliveries.

implements.description: UX Module Contract verbs the module implements.

renders.description: Per-artifact-type render strategy. Keys are canonical artifact mime-like types (CHOICES U-0006). Values are render strategies — 'unsupported' means the bookie will skip delivery to this module for that artifact type.

can_retract.description: True if the module can undo a render (edit/delete external message, hide UI element). Email-style modules set false; the bookie will mark loser deliveries retracted without invoking retract.

cli.description: Binary on PATH that implements the module entrypoint (render/retract operations on hitl_deliveries rows).

pusher.description: Optional pusher daemon binary for async mediums (Discord, email). Null/omitted for sync mediums (TUI, webui) that poll the ledger directly.
